reviews.text: [h1] 2.5D像素风与刷子游戏的精彩结合 [/h1] 《The Rangers In The South》是一款2.5D像素风格的带有Rogue元素的ARPG，玩家可以在地图上五个不同的地形里自由地探索，不断地击杀怪物、获得装备、提升等级、获得技能，从而打造最强的角色。 [h2] 有趣的玩法系统和爽快的战斗体验 [/h2] 游戏共有五种地形，每种地形都有一定数量的地牢，地牢里的宝箱和守关的BOSS会爆出非常不错的装备，所以地图可以不探全，但是地牢一定不能错过。装备分为物理和魔法两大类，物理系武器又有剑盾、双手剑、弓箭、战斧等细分，每种近战武器的战斗动作都是不同的，非常用心；法系武器则是分为不同元素属性的法杖。武器品质从白、蓝、紫、金逐渐提升，越高品质的武器带有的词条也就越多，低等级的高品质武器可能会比高等级的低品质武器更为实用。当解锁了雪山山顶的一个铸造装备的地点之后，可以消耗15个击杀精英怪或者金色动物掉落的“随机铸造绿色品质的装备，这类装备的数值和词条要更为强大。 每升一级，玩家可以选取一个技能，可以在主动技能或者被动技能中选择，也可以消耗神币重新roll技能。搭配好被动属性提升的方向，以及打群体AOE的技能和对单体强力输出的技能，才可以更好的生存下来更快的消灭敌人。我走的是盾士流，堆防御，闪避和盾牌攻击，一路上顺风顺水，打起来慢的话更新一下武器就好。不过建议到雪山前，多刷点精英怪掉落的“神币”，集齐一套绿色装备再去打雪山怪。最后一张图的数值实属太高了，我的防御流硬生生被小怪打死了，身上还没带复活卷轴，就这样永远的死掉了，只能期待二世继承一代的遗物复仇成功了。 整体上刷装备、爽金币的时候小怪基本没什么威胁，精英怪好好释放几个技能也能很稳妥的击杀。玩起来割草感很强，配合游戏像素风的画面，有一种莫名的爽感。 [h2] 目前存在的一些不足 [/h2] 1、一些山坡边缘很容易卡住玩家操纵的角色，有一次我从山坡上想往下跳走捷径，结果被卡在了边缘位置，上也上不去，下也下不来，只能传送回家，重新跑一遍图。 2、金色装备的掉率有点低，我从开始刷到雪山，地牢基本上全清了，只爆出来过两个金色装备，其中一个还是前期4级的剑，后期根本用不上。 3、希望能加入一些独一无二的BOSS，精英怪的体型和战力没有什么压迫感。 [h1] 总结 [/h1] 《The Rangers In The South》是一款有趣的2.5D像素风格的带有Rogue元素的ARPG，游戏的角色会有永久死亡机制，所以一定要带好复活卷轴。整体上的玩法是不断的刷小怪、清地牢，探索宝箱与祭坛，开拓游戏的迷雾地图。游戏的装备系统类似暗黑破坏神玩法，需要不断的刷装备，直到发现适合自己流派的装备；技能系统偏向Rogue玩法，每升一级随机刷新几个装备，需要在里面任选其一。总体来说，游戏的刷怪的爽感是非常强的，游戏的打击感和技能特效在整个像素风画面下表现的也很不错。推荐喜欢像素风刷子游戏的玩家尝试游玩！ [quote]关注「 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/42276832//]鸿源鉴游组」 [/url] [/quote] [u][b] 会当逢佳游，始可见鸿源。 [/b][/u]

Only just started the game but the art style and opening already ooze charm, well worth the price of entry at only 3.99, I'm extremely excited to experience this game further and I definitely want to see a developer with this level of quality and creativity succeed in their endeavors, absolutely suggest picking this one up! Combat at the start seems simplistic but the free form class building already has me enticed can't wait to see where this game and developer goes, especially for a solo dev! Also there is an amazing posted review in Chinese posted by the Hongyuan Gaming Review Group I'll post it here translated to English for reference for now in case anyone looking for more info on this game! The Perfect Blend of 2.5D Pixel Art and Loot-Based Gameplay "The Rangers In The South" is a 2.5D pixel-style ARPG infused with Rogue-like elements. Players can freely explore five different terrains on the map, slay monsters, acquire equipment, level up, and gain skills to create the ultimate character. Fun Gameplay Mechanics and Satisfying Combat The game features five terrains, each with a number of dungeons. While it’s optional to fully explore the map, the dungeons are a must-visit for their treasure chests and dungeon bosses, which drop excellent equipment. Equipment is categorized into physical and magical types. Physical weapons include subcategories like sword-and-shield, greatswords, bows, and battle axes, each with unique combat animations that feel meticulously designed. Magical weapons consist of staves with different elemental attributes. Weapons come in tiers of quality: white, blue, purple, and gold. Higher-tier weapons offer more attributes. A high-quality, low-level weapon might outperform a higher-level, low-quality weapon. Once you unlock the forge at the snowy mountain peak, you can spend 15 “elite monster drops” or golden animal drops to randomly forge green-tier equipment. These items have stronger stats and attributes. Every time you level up, you can select a skill from either active or passive options. You can also use special coins (“divine coins”) to re-roll the available skills. Balancing passive attribute enhancements with area-of-effect (AOE) and single-target burst skills is key to survival and faster enemy elimination. I opted for a shield build, focusing on defense, evasion, and shield attacks. It was smooth sailing most of the time, and when things got slow, upgrading weapons solved the problem. Before venturing into the snowy mountains, I recommend farming more elite monsters for “divine coins” and assembling a full set of green-tier equipment. However, the difficulty spikes significantly in the final map. My defensive build was overwhelmed by regular mobs, and without a resurrection scroll in my inventory, my character faced permanent death. Now, I can only hope my second-generation character will avenge the first by inheriting their equipment. Overall, farming gear and collecting coins feels relatively risk-free as basic mobs pose little threat. Elite monsters can be safely defeated with proper skill usage. The gameplay feels like mowing down hordes of enemies, which, combined with the pixel-art visuals, delivers an oddly satisfying experience. Current Issues Pathfinding Issues: It's easy to get stuck on terrain edges. Once, I tried to jump down a slope as a shortcut but ended up trapped on the edge, unable to move up or down. I had to teleport home and redo the map. Low Drop Rate for Gold-Tier Gear: From the beginning to the snowy mountains, despite clearing almost all the dungeons, I only found two gold-tier items. One was a level-4 sword that was useless in the later stages. Boss Design: The lack of unique boss designs is noticeable. Elite monsters lack a sense of scale or power that feels threatening. Conclusion "The Rangers In The South" is an engaging 2.5D pixel-style ARPG with Rogue-like elements. The game features permanent death mechanics, so always keep a resurrection scroll handy. The core gameplay revolves around farming mobs, clearing dungeons, looting treasure chests and altars, and uncovering the fog of war on the map. Its equipment system is reminiscent of Diablo, requiring players to farm constantly until they find gear that suits their build. The skill system leans toward Rogue-like randomness, as leveling up refreshes a random selection of skills, from which you must pick one. In summary, the game excels at delivering the thrill of monster farming, with satisfying combat and impressive skill effects that shine in its pixel-art style. A must-try for fans of pixel art and loot-driven games!

[quote][h1]一款意犹未尽的游戏[/h1][/quote] 入手体验这款游戏的理由也很简单，本作的画风在我看来是和鼎鼎有名的《八方旅人》系列是有那么三分相似的。 实际入手体验后，这款游戏的给我的整体印象就是：游戏内容亟待填充 在这款游戏中玩家会扮演一个传统的角色——勇者，不过在这里他们最新的名字是游侠，我们要做的就是对抗这篇土地上的恶魔，可以说这是一个非常常规的游戏背景。 游戏内采用即时战斗的方式，我们在这款游戏内共计可以装备主武器、副手武器两类武器，甚至是我们完全可以做一个双刀流剑士或是左法杖右砍刀的“近战法师”，当然选择做一个传统的持盾骑士都取决于我们自己。 这种同时装备两把武器而不用玩家来回切换的系统是我认为游戏内最精彩的地方。 甚至说游戏内的爽感很大程度上就是由此而来的。 因为实际体验下来后你会发现游戏内的敌人种类非常稀少，基本每个大区域内的不同类型敌人仅仅只有2~3个，这还是包括了BOSS在内的。 这也就导致玩家在经过开头的新鲜期后很容易就陷入到长期的无聊长草阶段，游戏内虽然设计出了一个看似成熟的近战和远程攻击和成长体系，但实际上你会发现在这款游戏内法术强度是远高于物理的。 比如我一开始选择的是近战职业，到了后面不如吸引敌人一起一个火球直接炸死来的爽. 所以我希望这款游戏能更多的填充大世界内容，以及增加怪物种类吧，这样才能避免玩家陷入持续的长草期。 [quote]关注鉴赏组：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45134494]浮生评测[/url] ←"浮生若梦，一鉴倾心，邀您共赏人间烟火" 加入Steam组：[url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/LLFLLFF]浮生评测[/url]←“一起追寻'浮生若梦'般的游戏体验” 开始“浮生若梦”鉴赏组的奇幻之旅！[/quote]

I really want to recommend this game, it's fun at the start, but numerous issues quickly pop-up as you continue to play. Most of these are issues with the gameplay should have honestly been in from the get go. This isn't an early access title, and for a full release the amount of QoL missing is wild; No way to rebind keys No ability to keep attacking by holding down left/right click No way to drop any gear off that's in your inventory after you kill the demon lords (not equipped items, I mean loose in inventory) The inability to use dual-stick controls with a controller (also applies to Steamdeck) Sound effects still playing even if you turn them down to 0, such as weapon swings, pick-up sounds etc. There are plenty of other issues, that are gameplay related, such as the random loot not having strength correlating to rarity/level, or the weird inclusion of a hunger mechanic (just why?) which doesn't mesh well at all with the rest of the game. All of this adds up to something that right now makes the game just not 'fun' after you get over the initial honeymoon period. Hopefully some of these will change sooner rather than later because despite them I still initially enjoyed the game, and the premise is very promising.

[h1]徒有皮肉的爽刷割草[/h1] [h2]游戏推荐指数：★★★★★☆☆☆☆☆[/h2] [quote]买肯定是要买的，玩肯定是不玩的 快来关注[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/38222893/] G胖受害者鉴赏家[/url] 让选择游戏变得更加简单[/quote] 《The Rangers In The South》是一款2.5D像素风格肉鸽刷子游戏，玩家需要扮演游侠一族，抵抗怪物的入侵，在不同的区域清扫怪物，爆出高级的装备，提升等级来获取技能，闯荡隐秘的地牢，激活带来增益的魔法石，爽快的消灭在你眼前的敌人。 [h2]爽快的战斗[/h2] 作为一个刷子游戏，游戏基本要素齐全，自由空旷的的地图上堆满了怪物。角色一开始就能从法师弓箭手近战三种选择初始装备，但对后续没有任何限制，玩家可以使用战斧、双手剑、战矛等多式武器战斗，每种武器的战斗动作都不相同，装备也分为四种级别，金色传说具有更多更高的词条。通过击杀敌人获取经验，到达一定数量后玩家就可以休整升级，升级可以选择一个基础属性增加，比如移速爆伤防御等等，更可以选择一个技能来组件自己的流派，技能获取的机会只有升级，所以尤为重要，最多可以携带5个主动技能，被动技能不限，但要注意技能的使用限制，比如有的必须要武器但不能是法杖，有减少一半cd但是攻速全失的施法者。除此以外，玩家还能在地图上寻找魔法石和地牢，魔法石能永久加成生命，通过地牢可以永久提升伤害。为什么要强调永久，因为游戏是永久死亡，死亡后仓库和一半的金币会保留，地图探索进度也会保留，等级装备只能重头再来，也是技能buid失误后的第二次机会。 [h2]空乏的内容[/h2] 整个地图虽然很大，但是除了怪真的什么都没有，只能全图走一遍，清完地牢和魔法石赶去下一个地图。怪物模型也很少，一个地区就2-3个模型，boss也仅仅是简单的体型变大，导致很快就失去了战斗的乐趣。地牢真的昏暗无比，烛火的光仙令人不适，而且地图结构单一，就是开两个机关就到boss宝箱了，奖励也就是稀有装备，凑齐一身后就没有惊奇感。Npc功能也少，就是买卖和药水，而且药水一瓶占一个格子，本来背包就很小，更是捉襟见肘。 最最重要的一点，虽然2.5d美术很好，但是地区全是统一的色调深深伤害了我的眼睛，特别是那个别扭的字体，多看两眼就恶心，天气系统很好，但是光暗交替更加重了恶心感。 [h2]总结[/h2] 具有一个刷子肉鸽基本的皮肉，但是缺乏骨架支撑，只能说是一滩。ui字体也需要加以改良，不然玩家很难坚持下去。但是游戏爽还是很爽的，因为游戏的移动速度很快，不存在拖拖拉拉，我上去就是一刀，打不过我就飞溜风筝。随机不到想要的技能就会很痛苦，辛辛苦苦刷机等于0提升。现阶段不推荐玩家尝试，暂且观望，期待开发者对游戏内容的填充。 [quote][h3]鉴赏员测评配置：[/h3] CPU：AMD Ryzen 7 5800H GPU：NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050ti Laptop 加入[url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/GgamePlayer] G胖受害者鉴赏组[/url] 和鉴赏员一起战斗！爽！ [/quote]

[quote] 欢迎大家加入[url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/yxwtb]游戏乌托邦[/url]&关注[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45337284/]乌托邦鉴赏家[/url]，我们评测各种类型的游戏，无论规模大小，无论题材风格！ [/quote] [h1]潜力与缺憾并存的2.5D像素风Roguelike冒险之旅[/h1] [b]前言：[/b] 《南方的游骑兵》（《The Rangers In The South》）是一款由DPA Studios开发并发行的2.5D像素风格下的Roguelike动作角色扮演类游戏（ARPG），其结合了肉鸽元素、刷装备系统以及经典像素美术风格，试图打造一个充满探索与成长乐趣的冒险世界。虽然本作以美术和潜在的爽感为卖点，但实际体验下来，它的优缺点都非常鲜明。 [b]亮眼的2.5D像素风：[/b] 本作的美术设计是其最吸引人的亮点之一。其采用了类似《八方旅人》的2.5D像素风格，将手绘场景与像素人物相结合，展现出层次丰富的世界。五种不同的地形生物群落，包括森林、雪山、荒漠等，虽然在设计上略显单调，但整体色调搭配和光影表现仍值得称赞，配上动态天气系统与昼夜交替机制，让场景更具生命力和代入感。 然而，过于单一的区域色调设计和UI界面略显陈旧的问题不可忽视。本作的字体设计略显别扭，虽有中文本地化，但是其暂时为机翻，长时间游玩容易产生视觉疲劳，影响整体沉浸感。 [b]自由而多样的战斗系统：[/b] 本作提供了丰富的装备选择，包括双手剑、战矛、弓箭、法杖等，每种武器都有独特的攻击动作与手感。玩家可以自由搭配主武器与副武器，甚至可以尝试“法杖+近战武器”这样的混搭组合，增添了构筑的自由度。 角色升级时，玩家将随机选择屏幕中展示的三个技能中的一个，来进行技能的构筑，这个机制虽然大大增加了策略性，但由于其随机性较高，且目前的技能池较浅，后期难以构建出令人满意的流派。 本作的战斗整体节奏较快，刷怪和割草的爽感较为突出。然而，技能的实用性和游戏平衡性仍有待优化。例如，法术输出明显强于物理系，导致近战玩家体验较为乏力。 [b]永久死亡与成长的设定：[/b] 本作采用了肉鸽最经典的永久死亡设定，角色死亡后装备、等级清零，但金币、仓库物品和地图探索进度会被保留，为下次冒险提供一定助力。 游戏地图中分布着魔法石和地牢，分别为玩家提供生命上限加成与永久伤害提升。这些永久增益为每次冒险提供了一定的成长目标。 [b]潜力未能完全释放的探索与装备系统：[/b] 本作的地图虽大，但其内容较为单薄，探索时缺乏一定的惊喜。除地牢和魔法石外，几乎没有额外的探索奖励。 此外，游戏的地牢设计过于单一，其基本流程是解开机关、击败Boss，然后领取装备。奖励虽有价值，但缺乏选择性和随机性，长时间游玩后容易产生厌倦感。 本作的装备系统分为白、蓝、紫、金四种品质，金色装备词条丰富，但掉率极低，玩家在长时间刷图后仍可能无法获得理想装备，体验略显挫败。 [h2]优缺点总结[/h2] [b]闪亮的优点：[/b] 1. 快节奏且手感优秀的战斗：战斗时的整体操作非常流畅，割草感十足。 2. 自由的技能构筑：没有职业限制，装备与技能的搭配创造了多种可能性。 3. 良好的美术表现：2.5D像素画风令人耳目一新，动态光影与天气系统增添了细节感。 [b]不足或缺点：[/b] 1. 目前内容较为单薄：怪物种类稀少，每个区域的敌人模型仅有2-3种，Boss设计更是缺乏压迫感。 2. 地牢的重复度高：地图结构和流程完全一致，奖励也过于单调，降低了探索的动力。 3. 职业间的平衡性不足：法术伤害明显强于物理流派，且技能构筑随机性过高，影响体验。 4. UI与汉化问题：目前UI中的汉字太小且难以辨认，虽然支持中文但是目前为机翻。 [b]总结：[/b] 《南方的游骑兵》是一款充满潜力但仍需打磨的2.5D像素风ARPG。它为喜欢刷子游戏的玩家提供了流畅的战斗体验和自由的构筑可能性，但内容单薄、平衡性和UI设计问题限制了它的长久吸引力。如果你热爱像素风肉鸽，并愿意接受游戏现阶段的不足，那么它可能是一款值得尝试的作品；但如果你期待一款成熟而丰富的冒险体验，建议暂时观望，等待后续更新填补内容空白。

TLDR: great game, but takes little time to kill final boss, almost zero replay value. It's really fun for first ~5 hours until beat the final boss, then you restart and monsters get +10% hp and dmg. So you need to beat him again, now you know how to level up faster, may have some gear stashed, some gold is carried over. So it's few hours of grind, until you do the same... and the same... until boss gets so strong that you must grind few extra hours on max level to get divine items, beat him and farm all of that again because you restart naked and lvl1. Combat feels satisfying, build variety is good enough for such a small game. But it gets annoyingly repetitive quite fast. Also after you find a build that suits you best you will stick to it, stash corresponding gear for different levels to speed-up next walkthrough which would result in totally zero variety.

I think this game has a lot of potential. Granted for such a low priced game, you can't expect much. I did a bit of research on the Devs, and there isn't much, so there's no way of telling if it's a Team, or just a single person. However they're based in Santiago, Chile Being it was just released 3 days prior to this review, a fairly bare bones road map of development, nor an established history I can't say I've got high hopes for this game unless they actively update the game regularly with new features. So far I've seen a lot of requests for multiplayer, but there's a few other things I'd like to see. I.E. 1) Multiplayer support - It's fairly high on the requests 2) Craftable or upgradable items - During my play I've come across rings, capes/backpacks that quite literally do nothing for the player, and appear fairly frequently. (Essentially useless items) 3) Larger & more diverse biomes 4) A small town in each biome that have/sell items that correspond with the area's level 5) NPC's with more purpose (maybe some that give quests), provide some lore or history building within the world of Rangers in The South The list could go on, and nobody should expect these kinds of things to happen right away, but these would be great steps toward a game with quite literally A LOT of potential.

The art style is what made me decide to buy this game lol The pixel art style seriously reminded me of Octopath and Ragnarok Online. If you’ve played roguelikes before, you know how addictive they can be! And you will die, like A LOT. Especially when you enter the second zone. The first zone makes you feel OP, but the difficulty ramps up as you explore further. Currently, the game is single-player only, but I can’t help imagining how much fun it would be to play with friends. I usually like to try and finish games before I review them, but the balance is so far off on this one that I don't feel like I'll be finishing it anytime soon. Overall I've had a good time with the game, but there are some glaring issues. My major issue with the experience is the lack of meaningful balance of progression. When you're adventuring around the first area you can level to about 10 or so before you stop getting any exp from the enemies. Dungeons still provide a decent chunk, but the walls are hard to maneuver and sometimes the levers required to open up your path are hidden behind walls making them all but invisible. Thusly the dungeons are a slog. At the end of the Second area, (The Forest) You'll be around level 12-13. The items will have you one-hit killing the enemies if your gear is on level. The third area (the Desert), you'll wrap up around level 16-17. Now either you go back to the desert and run dungeons to level up drastically or when you get to the next area a small group of enemies (that for the rest of the experience would be no problem) will kill you in two to three hits ending your already pretty lengthy run. If you make it to the fourth zone and are at around level 20 or so, your run will have taken about 2-3 hours. To make it that far only to be blindsided by drastically more powerful foes than the relevant enemies in previous areas after that amount of time is pretty irritating. Some other minor to major gripes that I've had are as follows: The shop in the starter town is the only one in the whole game as far as I've seen and I've cleared nearly the whole map. Its inventory doesn't improve as you progress through the game. Meaning that when you return to town to sell your gear, the only items available are far below your level and too weak to be useful. The inventory is really small and fills up constantly. The portal back to town takes an absurd amount of time to cast. The enemies spawn randomly and pop in from nowhere, not even off screen. (This isn't an issue for the majority of the game as the enemies are basically just fodder that go down in one to two hits unless you're super under geared.) However it is an issue for the fourth area where the enemies will pop into existence in large groups, (including bosses), move at lightning speed (making it impossible to outrun or kite them), and slay you in short order. The divine coins are a neat idea, but for some reason every time I use them to reroll, I get into debt and need to go through 3-5 runs grinding them out to get back to where I can use them again. The price of the reroll also doesn't match the cost when you actually use them. The debt doesn't clear when you die and respawn with a new character. Money is basically meaningless as there's nothing to spend it on. Items show a value that is reflected nowhere in the game as selling them to the shop will only net you pennies on the dollar. IE I was selling my Lvl 16 gear with a listed value of over 500 for 40 to 50 at the shop. The only purchasable item worth buying is a scroll of revival that doesn't even work. In the shop it is listed at 5k gold as "Scroll of Revival". Its description indicates that you'll respawn in town with all your gear if you die. Once purchased or found in the world however, the description reads "Scroll of Revive Other". I wasn't aware that co-op was a thing as the steam page says this is a single player game and there is seemingly no way to invite anyone to play with you. The 'Golden' Version of the animals are fast and durable and will frequently outrun the player and disappear off the map where they despawn. This creates a real issue as they are the only way to get the Divine coins for skill rerolls until much later in the game. This usually leads to the player being forced to pick unusable or lackluster skills that don't match their build or weapons. The combo system that allows the player to chain enemy kills for bonus EXP randomly bugs out and doesn't generate a chain for seemingly no reason. I've gone through whole areas without it generating a single chain, despite absolutely tearing through the foes therein. There is no fast travel point in the desert at all. Its there for all three of the other areas, but for some unknown reason, doesn't exist in the desert. (This is a minor issue as there is literally no reason to use these fast travel points due to the portal spell you have from the start.) That said having a completely superfluous fast travel system seems like a waste of effort. There are zero NPCs that are good for anything for the whole experience. Given how useless the shops are, (as previously noted), that's not altogether surprising, but even the random "Ranger"s that you run across aren't helpful for anything. There are no quests or missions to accomplish throughout the whole experience. The whole game is literally just a slog of moderately entertaining combat, grinding through enemies that may as well be floor traps as they don't do any meaningful damage or pose any challenge until the fourth area where they are stupidly powerful and fast. I suppose for the $3.99 price tag this is what I should have expected, but I was hoping for more. I've purchased many games for similar prices and had more favorable experiences. I see frequent updates from the Developer so at least they're trying to continue development, but why, then, is this game not an Early Access title? Were it EA, I wouldn't even question the jank or lack of balance. I hope to see these issue addressed, but I can't in good conscience recommend the game in its present state.

[quote] 欢迎大家加入[url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/yxwtb]游戏乌托邦[/url]&关注[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45337284/]乌托邦鉴赏家[/url]，我们评测各种类型的游戏，无论规模大小，无论题材风格！ [/quote] [h2]游戏背景[/h2] 《The Rangers In The South》是一款由DPA Studios工作室研制宣发的一款2.5D像素风开放世界肉鸽动作角色扮演游戏。玩家将在一个被称为南方大陆的奇幻世界展开冒险，这片大陆充满了无尽的秘密、古老的神话以及各种各样的妖魔。作为一名初来驾到的游侠，你将在这里探索未知的区域，收集强力的装备，解锁多样的技能，并逐步揭开南方大陆背后的故事。 [h2]游戏玩法[/h2] 本作的玩法很有新意，剔除了传统角色扮演游戏中的剧情、任务、支线等系统，玩家从刚来到一个落脚的村庄，了解了一下基本的操作玩法后，便没有任何明确的目的地，全靠玩家自由探索。 除了最开始让玩家选择初始武器以外，剩下的一切怪物分布，地形，洞窟，掉落的装备全是系统随机生成的，这意味这每次战斗你的体验将全然不同。并且当角色击杀敌人升级时，可以在随机的天赋树选择强化，并且随机选择一个主动或者被动技能， 游戏中有饥饿度和血量两个状态需要玩家注意，当饥饿值不足时，玩家会降低移动速度并且受到持续伤害，可以通过击杀地图上的一些自然生物获得肉恢复饥饿，当饥饿度高的时候还会增加角色的自然生命恢复速度。而当角色血量归零时，角色便会永久死亡，但是你可以保留该角色取得的所有近战，例如解锁的地图、发现的奖励和地点和50%的金币等等。 [h2]游玩感想[/h2] 本作大胆的抛弃了传统角色扮演游戏的一切束缚，将肉鸽要素融合进来，玩家只需要不断的杀敌打宝，前往更高级的地区就可以了。完全随机生成的天赋以及技能，让玩家可以没有任何拘束的搭配自己的角色构筑，非常自由。 但是由于目前游戏还在EA阶段，也存在不少需要改进的地方，例如地图很大但是过于空洞，除了怪物、随机生成的地窖、就是增加属性的石头，玩到后面容易枯燥。并且文字方面看着比较难受，希望后期可以改进。 [h2]总结[/h2] 总的来说，这是一款结合了肉鸽要素，没有任何任务和目标的角色扮演游戏，可以体验到最纯粹的打怪构筑的快乐，内容目前比较有限，地图空洞，希望制作组不断完善。

Played this about one week after its initial release. Title is fun, but the Dev team needs to fix some simple things that impact player experience. I played on controller, PS5 to be exact, which has no support currently. The Dev team can easily copy the template for the Xbox controller they are using and change icons for the correct PlayStation ones. I found the sound volume / option increments of 20% being a poor choice, if by design each 1% cant be controlled, please add at least increments of 5% to allow us to better control our experience. Upon leveling up. The options highlight is very poorly done especially for controller, please add a highlighted blinking boarder or something else that gives greater clarity in the UI on which option is selected. Sometimes the options are even un-highlighted via the current small fade in base color, for some reason without giving any indication of what is currently selected. My guess is this only happens when the highlighted option is the one that the controller initially locks onto. There needs to be a autofire for holding down the basic attack buttons via bow / melee weapon. ( Didn't try a wand.) If this is intended to be a level up passive, that's fine. I just didn't see it in my play through and went through about 20x re-rolls as well. I do think it would be better to just have it as a default for this style of game. Auto pickup is very annoying with limited space, there should be a way via controller to stand over the item, see the stats, and choose to pick it up. Had several issues with dropping multiple items at once while discarding things from inventory. (As in the item I choose + other random items were discorded for some reason.) Had duping issues with selling to the vendor, as well as dropping items. Please understand these are issues I've witnessed at the time of this review, and hopefully they are fixed in a timely fashion. If they are I will happily edit this review once I confirm the above has been fixed.

"Charming Roguelite with Potential" Rangers in the South is a charming Roguelite ARPG with a unique "generational" system where your child inherits your progress after you die. This adds a layer of depth and encourages strategic risk-taking. The pixel art style is visually appealing, though more gear variety would be welcome. The core gameplay loop is fun, but can become repetitive. Progression through world objectives and shared bonuses across generations provides a sense of persistent advancement. While the current skill tree and death-related mechanics are limited, Rangers in the South shows promise. It's a good value for the price and offers an engaging early access experience. Key takeaways: Pros: Unique "generational" system, charming pixel art, engaging core gameplay. Cons: Repetitive combat, limited gear variety, room for improvement in skill tree and death mechanics. I've tried to maintain the key points while significantly reducing the character count. Hopefully, this version fits comfortably within Steam's limits! [h1][b]3D像素风小体量角色冒险+肉鸽游戏[/b][/h1] 《The Rangers In The South 南方游侠》是一款采用了3D像素风的动作RPG游戏，其在此类游戏的冒险旅程中融入了Rogue升级要素，配合简单的动作系统，体验还不错。 这是一片巨大的奇幻大陆，人类本来在此安稳的定居，但有一天火山爆发唤醒了野兽和恶魔，身为南方游侠的主角为了保护家园就此踏上了征程。 本作采用了类似于HD-2D的画风，但并不完全一样，游戏以俯视角展开，画面表现中规中矩。 游戏不强制冒险路线，玩家可操控角色自由行动，世界内充满了兽人、野兽、怪物等敌人。 接近这些敌人后其会主动攻击角色，按下左键可使用装备的武器来攻击，右键则可以举起护盾来防御，前期攻击的频率较低，玩家可在攻击间隙使用护盾格挡伤害。 游戏拥有头盔、披风、项链、戒指、护甲、鞋子、武器、盾牌等装备栏位，和敌人进行战斗、开启宝箱、在商店购买等均可以获取装备，装备有等级要求和品质属性。 武器方面弓箭没有箭矢的需求，玩家可尽情输出，加上较远的攻击范围，表现很强势，非常推荐。 游戏体量较小，但却拥有昼夜系统、饥饿值系统等玩法， 每经过一天，玩家都可以进行一次构筑，除了选择生命值、攻击力、攻击速度等属性外，还可选择一些特殊的能力，如获得一只跟随作战的宠物、使用弓箭时有几率一次性射出两支、生命值过低时护甲增加等。 也可以获得一些主动性技能，如闪电链、火焰护甲等，这些技能无需法力值即可释放，仅需要等待较短时间的冷却，也非常好用。 在野外探索还可以找到一些祝福神龛，获得诸如攻击力、移动速度的加成。 每到一个区域可以开启本区域的传送法阵，此外玩家还可以随时按键进行吟唱回城，这个操作会留下一个传送门，对着传送门互动可以快速回到此前的位置。 整体来说，这部《南方游侠》的表现还可以，看着其貌不扬，但系统框架挺完整，融入了Rogue玩法后角色会不断变强，如果能增强下战斗手感就更不错了。 [quote]关注[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/36224058/]老实人鉴赏家 [/url] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/laoshirenLSR]老实人评测[/url]：独立游戏爱好者聚集地，黄油绅士交流中心。 不错过游戏的亮点，不放过游戏的槽点，带给玩家最直观的测评感受。[/quote]

《The Rangers In The South》是一款融合了Roguelike要素的2.5D像素风ARPG ，玩家将在魔幻且广阔的南方大陆展开一场自由度极高的冒险。游戏舍弃了传统RPG的任务和线性叙事，采用完全开放的探索模式，让我们完全凭借自身想法选择前进方向，探索未知的地牢，消灭面前所有敌人，并在不断的战斗中成长，成为最强的“南方游侠”！ 《The Rangers In The South》采用2.5D像素风格，表现上不如《歧路旅人》等现如今有名HD-2D像素风格，但也比常见的像素风格来得精细，虽说初玩总会感觉画面有点模糊，但在习惯之后，会发现游戏在光影表现上还是颇为不错的。游戏采用了无缝大地图设计，森林、荒漠、雪原等地形构筑得各具特色，搭配动态天气系统，使整个世界显得更加生动生动。 游戏的核心玩法就是自由的探索、战斗与角色成长。游戏有着多种武器供我们选择，近战的长剑、长枪、双手大刀，远程的弓箭、法杖等，每种武器都有独特的攻击方式与战斗手感，我们可以选择混搭使用来构不同的战斗BD。游戏的战斗节奏流畅，攻击、闪避、防御的操作手感都相当不错，不同的武器搭配不同的技能的也让游戏的战斗变得更是多样化。 游戏有着些许Roguelike元素，每次角色升级的时候（经验满后按G键），我们都可以在随机生成的技能池中挑选角色的强化方向，是学习被动技能还是主动技能，是提升主要属性还是剑走偏锋的学习次要属性，全由我们自己来下决策！反正就是要我们自己可以根据局势调整战斗BD，让每个角色都能拥有完全不同的战斗风格。另外，游戏还有饥饿系统这么一个存在感相当低下的生存系统，我们在大地图探索的时候，需要顺路狩猎或采集植物来当食物，用以维持基本的生存条件（回血相关）。 游戏采用永久死亡机制，角色死亡后会失去当前的等级和装备，但已解锁的地图、部分金币和特定成长要素会被保留，我们可以根据结算获得的“神石”来提升下一个角色，也能在下个角色直接把游戏难度提高来获取更大的挑战，这些设置能让我们每次再战都能有不一样的新鲜感。 整体而言，《The Rangers In The South》算是一款强调探索与成长的像素风Roguelike ARPG，凭借其开放世界设计、自由度极高的战斗系统和充满变数的成长机制，来为像素风游戏注入一剂不一样的活力，虽说像素画面的展示略微费眼，但游戏游玩机制的优秀毋庸置疑，还是相当值得推荐的！ [quote]欢迎关注我们的鉴赏家:[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/35402982/]走心评测[/url] ←遵从内心，写出真实感受 欢迎加入我们Steam组:[url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/ZXPC]走心评测[/url]←点击加入，一起探索游戏的乐趣 喜欢这篇评论，也麻烦点个赞，让更多人能够看到！[/quote]

The Rangers in the South, developed and published by DPA Studios, is a 2.5D pixel-art action roguelike RPG that offers a nostalgic journey reminiscent of SNES-era classics. Released on January 9, 2025, the game presents a charming yet challenging experience, blending exploration, combat, and character customization in a procedurally generated world. The game's visual design is one of its standout features. The hand-drawn environments, combined with pixel-art characters and enemies, create a vibrant and immersive world. Players traverse through diverse biomes, each with unique aesthetics and challenges. The attention to detail in the environments encourages exploration, rewarding players with hidden secrets and points of interest. Gameplay in The Rangers in the South revolves around creating unique characters through a combination of abilities, traits, and procedurally generated equipment. This system allows for a variety of playstyles, as players can experiment with different combinations to find strategies that suit their preferences. The absence of predefined classes further enhances this customization, offering a flexible approach to character development. Combat is fast-paced and engaging, with players facing off against hordes of enemies across various dungeons and villages. The procedurally generated nature of these environments ensures that no two runs are the same, maintaining a sense of unpredictability and excitement. However, some players have noted that enemy variety can be limited, leading to repetitive encounters over time. One of the core mechanics of the game is permadeath, which adds a layer of tension and strategy to each run. While death is irreversible, progress is not entirely lost; exploration achievements, items, and gold are retained, allowing players to build upon their previous experiences. This feature encourages players to learn from their mistakes and approach each playthrough with a fresh perspective. Despite its strengths, the game is not without its criticisms. Some reviewers have pointed out that the lack of quality-of-life features, such as controller support, can detract from the overall experience. Additionally, while the game offers a solid foundation, certain aspects, like dungeon design and combat depth, could benefit from further refinement. The game's relatively short length, approximately 4–5 hours, may also leave players wanting more content. In conclusion, The Rangers in the South is a promising title that captures the essence of classic action RPGs while introducing modern roguelike elements. Its engaging gameplay, coupled with its charming visuals and deep customization options, make it a worthwhile experience for fans of the genre. While there are areas that could benefit from improvement, the game's potential is evident, and it will be interesting to see how DPA Studios continues to develop and expand upon this title in the future. Rating: 8/10

Honest review: This game has been in development for nearly a year after its release now, but it has clear signs of a developer or developers that use AI to code. Many of the reviews must be fake (only a handful over a couple hours playtime, too), as it has many glaring issues in base functions. Some passives take active slots and don't activate, many actives do not work at all or only some of the time. Some of the numbers do not correctly scale or multiply, and the randomization tends to hide that behind 'random' rolls that are very much skewed. The food system is an afterthought, only limiting recovery over time and giving a small boost to health at the time of eating. The NPCs/Rangers/merchants are insignificant unless you grind and store money (the economy is easy, but top-tier gear and store item levels are random and seem to be a logarithmic scale) for even further grinds. The dungeons are 'random' but always a very easy generic layout, and if you get a bad roll on loot you might as well bank and restart because the experience gain without massive AOE skills is crawling. The terrain is bad, and you can get stuck in several places, which can get you killed quick. I don't particularly care about balance and difficulty in single-player games, but the many bugs and band-aids on this very simple game, combined with the suspiciously familiar sprites from a certain other popular game, has me leaning toward it being a money-grab made with AI. Buy at your own discretion.

[b]I'd give this game a neutral rating if I could. Will give it a positive review, since a negative feels a bit unfair.[/b] After 10 hours and 4 completed runs, all I can say is that this game could be so, so much more than it currently is, but it seems unlikely that it'll be developed any further. Visually, it's great. Core gameplay loop is decent and fun, but is lacking depth. In fact, every system in this game is lacking depth: - If you have any experience with rougelikes or ARPGs, it'll take you about an hour to figure out the strongest synergies. Given how easy it is to reroll abilities and passives, you'll be able to turn every run into a god run - The fishing system is pointless and doesn't add anything. It's faster to farm divine coins and food by killing enemies - you can finish the whole game without ever realizing there's a fishing minigame - The hunger / food system also adds nothing to the gameplay, it's just a chore to press F every 20s to eat - The game's difficulty scales too slowly. By the time I've hit difficulty 4, I was killing the last boss while being significantly below max level - just using all the level 5 bow-related perks - The enemies lack diversity and any sort of distinction beyond "runs at you to melee" and "runs near you to spam projectiles" - All boss mechanics are trivialized by any of the healing perks - you can just tank every hit and outheal them - For some reason, physical damage and attack speed scale with % bonuses, but magic damage is always a flat damage increase, meaning that magic damage is just worse in almost all builds. The only fun I had with mage builds was to bind all skills to the same button and spamming that. - All the achievements are bland and boring. I could go on and on, but I'm just frustrated. This game has a solid foundation and gameplay bones, but feels half-assed. Or kind of still in EA. There's also a bunch of typos in skill descriptions which feels sloppy. I don't regret picking it up on a 40% discount, but wouldn't pay full price for it.
